description: The home of 404 Error Found: five people, shared ideas, and a team worth choosing again. Explore CivicEye, AgriPulse and MetrikAI.

hero.eyebrow: A team we found. A team we choose.
hero.description:
Not just the projects we build.
The people we keep choosing.
hero.note: Different minds. Shared ideas. Our own little corner of the internet.

story.title: The best part was always the people.
story.intro: 404 Error Found is the team behind our shared projects, from a passion project to our NexHack trip and SIH work. This is a home for the things we build and the people who make building them worthwhile.
story.quote: If I had to choose a team all over again, I’d choose these people. Every single time.
story.gratitude: To Aswathram, Koushik, Himesh and Niranjhan: thank you for the ideas, the conversations, and for being the people I want beside me when we build something. CivicEye, AgriPulse and MetrikAI matter to me—but this team is what makes the work meaningful. I’m grateful for you, and I’d choose to work with you again and again.
story.author: Archit Renjeev
